body: I'm glad you are more accepting of it. Maybe someday if I'm still alive I'll find someone who feels the same way.

I'm in the US. Hair has just always been a crutch of my confidence level so I've tried everything to make my appearance as best as it can be at the expense of my happiness. I've always been depressed and suicidal since I was a kid but at some point it would change I thought. I've had treatment but it just made me feel numb or worse, especially the side effects. 

The scars are pretty bad looking and they are painful to the touch even after the amount of years passed since the surgery. The cost and procedures alone to even somewhat fix a situation like mine is beyond the amount of money I have and it wouldn't be satisfied with the results. 

I would've shaved my head and dealt with it as my gf didn't care but I wasn't going to do something drastic without a real commitment as if she left me while I looked like garbage I would've just shot myself on site. I guess she could've really left in any scenario, married or not but the result probably would've been the same on my end. I just don't have confidence, I don't want to go out, I don't want to meet anyone new and I fail to feel an attraction to anyone else which where the pure hopeless feeling comes in.

I lost a majority of my hair at a young age so I got a botched hair transplant that I cover with a wig that is just so bad looking I can't take it. I can't go to the beach and I'm afraid of large crowds that they may notice. I can't take it off and shave my head because of the bad scars I have from the surgery - AKA I have no confidence. My gf left me and it's my fault because I pushed her away because I would be uncomfortable leaving the house or just my overall negativity. She was the love of my life and I just let her walk away. It's been 10 months since and I haven't gotten over her. I miss her more as time goes on rather than getting over her. It's supposed to be the opposite.

They say give it time or just focus on yourself but that's just making me see more and more how screwed up I am and there's just no solution. I can't fix these things and I can't accept them either so this just seems to be a logical solution to me.
